# Sessions and Killzones > A TradingView Pine Script v6 indicator by [Sagar](https://github.com/Sagar4575) Visualises the four major FX market sessions and four ICT kill zones
Each session and kill zone is fully configurable — times, timezone, colours, box style, opening range, Fibonacci levels, bar colouring, candles, labels, and more.
